correctness.rationale: Exact zero- and twin-count means and Poisson zero factorial moments hold for all k_n/n -> 0. For c>0, the row-hypergeometric/independent-Bernoulli likelihood ratio for every fixed set of columns is 1+o(1) uniformly over rare events; weighted-word collision moments have n^2 s_2 -> lambda^2(e^c-1), n^h s_h -> 0 for h>=3. The graph expansion gives the required independent Poisson pair, and the deterministic separation criterion gives both CDFs. At c=0 Markov bounds exclude nonzero twins without assuming k_n diverges. The standalone exact verifier passed 57768 checks; finite checks do not establish asymptotic theorems.

originality.rationale: Novelty assessed for the precise joint independent Poisson limit of unseen columns and nonzero duplicate columns at p_n log n -> c, and both resulting full-recovery laws. Published focal articles establish the model and deterministic criteria; same-domain probability results give fixed-two coupon means and finite computations. These do not imply the positive nonzero-twin crossover parameter by their stated results. Related classical occupancy methods may have broader coverage; priority risk is disclosed.

value.rationale: The limit quantifies a natural and previously unresolved distinction between covering all coupons and distinguishing every label from group samples. Its sharp extra obstruction appears precisely when k_n is of order n/log n; the nonzero twin law provides a meaningful new regime and two explicit operational recovery distributions, not a routine substitution or incidental finite-slice number.
